market: Sultanate of Oman and wider GCC. Arabic/English bilingual products favored. Government digitalization push under Oman Vision 2040. Strong demand in education, healthcare, real-estate regulation, and SME digitization. Founder is a solo/small-team builder who prefers open-source, self-hostable stacks (Python, FastAPI, Odoo, AWS) and reuses proven components rather than building from scratch.

ventures.name: EnCoach
ventures.description: AI-powered edtech company. Proprietary AI Tutor Engine (DeepTutor) that generates structured course content for English language foundation programs (CEFR-aligned) at Omani universities: student eBooks, teacher packages, media, and interactive activities. Actively pursuing integrations with Arabic educational platforms. Interested in: tutoring agents, content generation, assessment/quiz engines, Arabic NLP, speech (TTS/ASR) for language learning, LMS integrations.

ventures.name: Al-Busalah
ventures.description: Albousalh (البوصلة, 'The Compass') — sovereign swarm-intelligence simulation and foresight platform for Oman's government, military, and enterprise sectors. Wraps the open-source MiroFish engine (behavioral/scenario simulation) in a culturally localized Arabic/RTL frontend. Core features: scenario comparison, stakeholder briefing generation, historical simulation library, confidence calibration, collaborative annotation, demographic overlays, alert/watch systems, decision audit trails. Adding quantitative time-series forecasting (TimesFM-style) and live accuracy tracking. Stack: Vue 3/Nuxt 3, TypeScript, Tailwind RTL, Pinia, ECharts, D3.js, PostgreSQL/Prisma. Interested in: multi-agent/swarm simulation frameworks, time-series forecasting models, scenario-planning and decision-support tools, data visualization libraries (D3/ECharts/graph viz), Arabic/RTL UI frameworks and component kits, geopolitical/demographic data tooling, confidence/uncertainty visualization, audit-trail and compliance logging systems.

ventures.name: Open City
ventures.description: Smart traffic platform for Omani cities: traffic monitoring, congestion analysis, and road-safety intelligence using cameras/CCTV, computer vision, and city data. Interested in: vehicle detection and counting models (YOLO-family), traffic-flow prediction, ANPR/plate recognition, GIS/mapping tools, edge AI for cameras (Jetson-class), smart-city dashboards.

ventures.name: Autism Medical
ventures.description: AI-assisted platform for autism care in Oman ('Autism AI'): screening and assessment support, therapy management, progress tracking, and parent-facing tools, Arabic/English, PDPL-compliant. Interested in: ML screening/diagnostic aids, behavioral analysis models, assistive/AAC communication tools, pediatric health record and scheduling systems.

ventures.name: SMART Mobility
ventures.description: Exclusive Omani distributor of battery-swap electric delivery motorcycles (TYCORUN). Interested in: fleet management software, battery/IoT telemetry, delivery-logistics optimization, EV charging/swap-station management tools.
